The unmodified `render_report.mjs` is from paper-deep-reader v4.0.1,
commit ab5e934, https://github.com/Kyy008/paper-deep-reader-skill.
Its MIT license is included alongside it. Dependencies are pinned in the parent
content directory's package-lock.json. The wrapper keeps the upstream strict
Markdown and KaTeX behavior, then externalizes verified images for static hosting.
